verification.notes: Draft: no curriculum officer has reviewed this pack. Unverified items: (1) the cbe_8_level percentage cut-offs are the bands printed in platform spec 03 section 5, which itself asks for confirmation against the current KNEC circular; (2) the Grade 12 exit assessment code KSSEA is the KNEC senior-school assessment name used here pending written confirmation; (3) senior-school subject combinations per pathway are illustrative, not the published KICD combination list; (4) pre-primary and primary learning-area names follow the KICD designs but were not checked line by line; (5) the 60/40 SBA/end-term weighting is a school default, not a KNEC composite. All five source URLs returned a live document on 2026-10-21, but their contents were not certified by a curriculum officer.
